mission.title: Sum of its Parts
mission.description: Find the program guarding the last device component and recover it.

npc.say: Oh yeah, one more thing... be sure to pick the right one. I'm not quite clear on what that bug would do to a bluepill, but it wouldn't be pretty.
You should talk to Hilario. He just got here the other day, and he doesn't really make too much sense all the time.

Hey, I hope you're here to do something about Hilario. He just came on board a few days ago, and he's already creeped out just about everybody. Sometimes it seems like he's talking to himself and laughing... you gotta do something!
I didn't think that was how you'd take care of Hilario... I think I'm gonna throw up...
Beats me. Have you asked Hilario about that yet? He just got here a few days ago. Seems a little weird, too.
I dunno. Stacey might know something for you.
Huh? Hey, I don't know... but Hilario sure gives me the creeps sometimes.

phase.briefing: One component of the device remains to be collected, {player}. Once again, the Merovingian has possession of this component. His continued attempts at obstruction are becoming almost... annoying. We have an operative, Aisleen, planted within his organization. You will rendezvous with her and continue the mission according to the intelligence she has gathered.

enter.say: Man, they're really keeping mum about this "device". I'd bet anything it's something to take on the Assassin. Anyhow, this is the meeting place. Should be a safe location, but keep an eye out all the same, 'kay?

talk.say: So... what's the password? Nah, just kiddin'. Agent Gray told me you'd be coming. Listen, the Merovingian hid the component in plain sight this time. It's in an office building near here, full of clueless bluepills. Now here's the twist: one of the "bluepills" is actually a program disguised as a human. It's controlling access to the component. I've got a specially engineered bug here that will decompile that program and bring down the security around the component.

done.say: All right, get out of here and I'll get the coordinates of that office building to you.

phase.briefing: I believe you understand the situation sufficiently, {player}. You must determine the identity of the program and give it the bug in order to gain access to the component. I urge you to investigate thoroughly before taking any action. We have no desire for you to reduce our energy source needlessly.

enter.say: Here's the office building Aisleen was talking about.

objective.text: Give the bug to the program

talk.say: Hey, beats me, I'm just a clueless bluepill, ya know?

done.say: All right, that was the one! There should be a secure room somewhere around here that just opened up.

objective.text: Get the component from the secure room

done.say: Great, that's the last component -- some sort of gun barrel. Better get out of there before the authorities show up.

phase.briefing: Proceed to the indicated location, where you will give the component to Agent Wilson.

enter.say: Agent Wilson should be waiting for you in here. Maybe we'll find out what the completed device is!

objective.text: Give the component to Agent Wilson

done.say: Wow, as forthcoming as ever. I guess we'll just have to wait and see what this great "device" is...

mission.finish: You will be notified of the device's use when you need to know such information, {player}. For now, be assured that we appreciate your service. Contact me soon. We are planning an operation against the Merovingian to remind him of his proper place.
